function: Convert electrical energy to rotational thrust
failure_effect: Complete loss of motor rotation → vehicle crash
potential_cause: Insufficient lubrication / contamination during assembly
recommended_action: Add bearing inspection step at motor install; specify grease type in BOM

function: Convert electrical energy to rotational thrust
failure_effect: Excessive vibration → structural fatigue of mount bracket
potential_cause: Damaged or contaminated rotor blades during handling
recommended_action: Implement dynamic balance check at motor receiving inspection

function: Convert electrical energy to rotational thrust
failure_effect: Electrical short → ESC shutdown → propulsion loss
potential_cause: Thermal cycling stress; manufacturing defect
recommended_action: Require 100% hi-pot test at supplier; add thermal shock screen

function: Convert electrical energy to rotational thrust
failure_effect: Demagnetization → power loss; potential fire risk
potential_cause: Incorrect motor specified for duty cycle; blocked airflow
recommended_action: Add thermal derating curve to motor spec; test at max load

function: Convert electrical energy to rotational thrust
failure_effect: Wrong thrust profile → flight control failure
potential_cause: Part number confusion on similar-looking variants
recommended_action: Implement barcode scan verification at motor installation station

failure_effect: Motor runs at wrong speed profile → unstable flight
potential_cause: Firmware version not validated against motor/FC combination
current_prevention_control: Firmware release notes reviewed at build
recommended_action: Lock firmware version in build traveler; add version check to EOL script

failure_effect: Mid-flight power cutoff → crash
potential_cause: Inadequate heatsinking; ambient temperature exceeded spec
recommended_action: Add 10°C thermal margin to ESC mounting design; validate in thermal chamber

failure_effect: Motor stops receiving throttle signal → vehicle drop
potential_cause: Wiring harness damage; connector vibration loosening
recommended_action: Add locking connector on ESC signal line; vibration test at system level

failure_effect: Intermittent / complete power loss
potential_cause: Poor wetting; thermal fatigue from power cycling
recommended_action: Increase x-ray sample rate to 20%; add thermal cycle screen

failure_effect: Motor timing mismatch → efficiency loss / instability
potential_cause: Calibration step skipped or documented incorrectly
recommended_action: Add mandatory calibration step with pass/fail criteria to build traveler

failure_effect: Blade separation → catastrophic imbalance → crash
potential_cause: Impact damage; material defect; fatigue from over-torque
recommended_action: Add dye-penetrant inspection to receiving; torque limiter on installation tool

failure_effect: Loss of aerodynamic profile → thrust asymmetry
potential_cause: CFRP layup defect; moisture ingress during storage
recommended_action: Add C-scan to receiving AQL plan for CFRP propellers; improve storage spec

failure_effect: Wrong performance curve → under/over thrust
potential_cause: Wrong part pulled from inventory; no pitch marking check
recommended_action: Add pitch laser-etch marking; implement scan-to-verify at assembly

failure_effect: Propeller detaches in flight → crash
potential_cause: Under-torque at installation; incorrect fastener
recommended_action: Use torque-indicating fasteners; add torque verification to build record

failure_effect: Drag increase → reduced endurance
potential_cause: Handling damage post-inspection
recommended_action: Add foam-lined storage trays; inspect immediately before installation

failure_effect: Motor misalignment → vibration → fatigue
potential_cause: Fixture wear; CNC program error
recommended_action: Tighten AQL from 1.0 to 0.4 for hole position; add SPC on CNC fixture

failure_effect: Structural failure → motor detachment → crash
potential_cause: Stress concentration; incorrect alloy; over-torque
current_prevention_control: FEA review in design; material cert required
recommended_action: Add stress-relief radius to design; specify 7075-T6 only in BOM

failure_effect: Poor motor contact → vibration transmission
potential_cause: Machining stress relief insufficient
recommended_action: Add stress-relief annealing step to manufacturing router

failure_effect: Loose motor over time → vibration increase
potential_cause: Insufficient thread engagement; wrong fastener grade
recommended_action: Specify thread insert (Helicoil) for high-cycle fastener interfaces

failure_effect: Wrong alloy → reduced strength margin
potential_cause: Material certs not verified at receiving
recommended_action: Add 100% PMI scan at receiving inspection for motor mount brackets

function: Transmit power and signal to motor/ESC
failure_effect: Intermittent power/signal → erratic motor behavior
potential_cause: Assembly error; connector design requires high insertion force
recommended_action: Add positive-lock connectors; add seating force verification to work instruction

function: Transmit power and signal to motor/ESC
failure_effect: Short circuit → fire risk or power loss
potential_cause: Inadequate routing protection in high-vibration zones
recommended_action: Add grommets/abrasion sleeves at all frame contact points; add to inspection checklist

function: Transmit power and signal to motor/ESC
failure_effect: Motor runs in reverse or not at all
potential_cause: Wiring error; missing polarization feature
current_detection_control: Functional motor spin test at EOL
recommended_action: Add polarized connector shrouds; implement spin-direction check in EOL software

function: Transmit power and signal to motor/ESC
failure_effect: Potential short; degraded signal integrity
potential_cause: Handling damage; sharp edge contact
recommended_action: Add insulation damage to receiving inspection AQL; improve packaging spec

function: Transmit power and signal to motor/ESC
failure_effect: Random power loss → flight instability
potential_cause: Vibration-induced fretting; poor crimp quality
current_prevention_control: Crimp quality spec in supplier requirements
recommended_action: Add crimp pull-test to receiving inspection; specify vibration-resistant crimp termination

failure_effect: Reduced power delivery → ESC brownout
potential_cause: High contact resistance; oxidation; undersized contact
recommended_action: Add contact resistance measurement to receiving AQL

failure_effect: Intermittent power → erratic flight behavior
potential_cause: Worn contact spring; incorrect mating cycle count exceeded
current_prevention_control: Mating cycle rating in connector spec
recommended_action: Add mating cycle tracker to battery swap log; replace connectors at spec limit

failure_effect: Connector melts → fire or power loss
potential_cause: Current draw exceeds connector rating; poor heat dissipation
current_detection_control: Thermal imaging at EOL under load
recommended_action: Uprate connector to next ampacity class; add thermal fuse in line

failure_effect: Battery connected backwards → immediate ESC/motor damage
potential_cause: Symmetric connector allows incorrect mating
current_prevention_control: Polarity labeling on connector and battery
current_detection_control: Visual polarity check in work instruction
recommended_action: Replace with asymmetric keyed connector to physically prevent reverse polarity

failure_effect: Increased resistance → heating → degraded performance
potential_cause: Exposure to oils, dust, moisture in assembly environment
recommended_action: Add connector cap/plug until mating; add cleaning step to assembly SOP

failure_effect: Joint loosens under vibration → component shift
potential_cause: Torque wrench not calibrated; SOP not followed
current_prevention_control: Calibrated torque tools; torque spec in SOP
recommended_action: Add digital torque tool with data logging; flag out-of-spec torques in real time

failure_effect: Insufficient clamp load → joint failure under load
potential_cause: Mixed inventory; no grade marking on small fasteners
recommended_action: Implement kitting by job traveler; add grade stamp requirement to fastener spec

function: Conduct heat from ESC to heatsink
failure_effect: Thermal resistance above design spec → overheating
potential_cause: Manual application variability; no thickness gauge used
current_prevention_control: TIM application procedure in work instruction
recommended_action: Add shim template for TIM application; add thickness check with feeler gauge

function: Conduct heat from ESC to heatsink
failure_effect: Thermal resistance increases with age
potential_cause: Low-grade TIM material; exceeding max operating temp
current_prevention_control: TIM material spec requires thermal conductivity rating
recommended_action: Upgrade to phase-change TIM; add thermal cycle qualification test

function: Transmit power and signal to motor/ESC
failure_effect: Wire caught in rotating propeller → crash
potential_cause: No wire length specification; inconsistent assembly
current_prevention_control: Wire routing diagram in work instruction
recommended_action: Add wire length to BOM; add wire-to-prop clearance check to EOL inspection
